sn35.117:1.1: pubbe me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
sn35.117:1.2: ye mayhaṃ pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra me cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu.
sn35.117:1.4: ye mayhaṃ bhikkhave pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra me attarūpena appamādo saticetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo.
sn35.117:1.5: tasmā tiha bhikkhave tumhākampi ye te pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra vo cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu.
sn35.117:1.6: tasmā tiha bhikkhave tumhākampi ye te pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra vo attarūpena appamādo saticetaso ārakkho karaṇīyoti. tasmā
sn35.117:1.7: tiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe. yattha cakkhu nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe …pe…
sn35.117:1.8: yattha jivhā nirujjhati rasasaññā ca virajjati …pe… se āyatane veditabbe.
sn35.117:1.9: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti.
sn35.117:1.10: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
sn35.117:2.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi
sn35.117:2.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho

sn35.117:2.4: yattha jivhā ca nirujjhati rasasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe …pe…
sn35.117:2.5: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti.
sn35.117:2.6: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti.
sn35.117:3.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
sn35.117:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
sn35.117:3.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti.
sn35.117:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn35.117:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ

sn35.117:6.1: seyyathāpi nāma āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa …pe…

sn35.117:8.5: saḷāyatananirodhaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ

sn35.117:11.1: paṇḍito bhikkhave ānando mahāpañño bhikkhave ānando
sn35.117:11.2: mañcepi tumhe bhikkhave etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha ahampi taṃ evameva byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ ānandena byākataṃ
sn35.117:11.3: eso cevassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
